description: This file defines classes and functions for managing fake class registration, script object handling, and object conversion in PyTorch's internal library, particularly for fake tensor and script object manipulation.

classes.name: FakeScriptObject
classes.description: Represents a fake script object that wraps a real object and provides controlled attribute access.

classes.name: FakeScriptMethod
classes.description: Represents a fake method associated with a FakeScriptObject, enabling method calls via torchbind.

classes.name: HasStaticMethodFromReal
classes.description: Protocol for classes that can be instantiated from a real torch.ScriptObject via from_real method.

classes.name: FakeClassRegistry
classes.description: Registry for storing and managing fake class implementations associated with qualified names.

methods.name: register_fake_class
methods.description: Registers a fake class for a given qualified name, requiring a from_real classmethod.

methods.name: deregister_fake_class
methods.description: Removes a registered fake class for a given qualified name.

methods.name: has_fake_class
methods.description: Checks if a fake class is registered for a given qualified name.

methods.name: find_fake_class
methods.description: Retrieves the registered fake class for a given qualified name, if any.

methods.name: _full_qual_class_name
methods.description: Constructs the full qualified class name string from a simple qualname.

methods.name: _is_script_object
methods.description: Checks if an object is a torch.ScriptObject of a specific qualified name prefix.

methods.name: _ns_and_class_name
methods.description: Splits a full qualified name into namespace and class name components.

methods.name: _find_fake_class_for_script_object
methods.description: Finds the registered fake class for a given script object.

methods.name: _fake_obj_from_real
methods.description: Creates a fake object from a real script object using the registered fake class.
